class.name: AudioStreamOpus
class.brief_description: A streaming Opus decoder for an AudioStreamPlayer.
class.description: Creates AudioStreamPlaybackOpus instances which decode queued Opus packets.

method.name: get_buffer_length
method.description: Returns the buffer capacity in seconds.

method.name: get_opus_sample_rate
method.description: Returns the Opus decoding sample rate.

method.name: set_buffer_length
method.description: Sets the buffer capacity in seconds.

method.name: set_opus_channels
method.description: Sets the decoded channel count to mono or stereo.

method.name: set_opus_sample_rate
method.description: Sets the Opus decoding sample rate.
